columns.name: district_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for the district.

columns.name: num_opened_accounts
columns.description: The number of accounts opened in the district, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_male_clients
columns.description: The number of male clients in the district, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: avg_transaction_amount_1997
columns.description: The average amount per transaction in 1997 (across all transaction types).

columns.name: num_accounts_with_load_finished_no_problem
columns.description: The number of accounts with loan contracts finished with no problems, replace NULL values with 0. No problems refers to status = 'A'.

columns.name: per_account_opened_1993
columns.description: The percentage of accounts from the district among all accounts opened in 1993.

columns.name: client_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for the client.

columns.name: birth_date
columns.description: The birth date of the client.

columns.name: amount_of_first_transaction
columns.description: the amount of the first transaction by the client, with ties broken by the descending order of the amount.

columns.name: largest_loan_amount
columns.description: The largest loan amount the client has taken. Loan the client has taken refers to disp.type = 'OWNER'

columns.name: num_withdrawals_in_cash_transactions
columns.description: The number of withdrawals in cash transactions by the client, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: avg_loan_amount
columns.description: The average loan amount the client has taken. Loan the client has taken refers to disp.type = 'OWNER'

columns.name: total_pay_for_all_transactions_1998
columns.description: The total amount the client paid for all of the transactions in 1998, replace NULL values with 0.
